value.rationale: The type B2 nilradical is the smallest non-simply-laced positive-root Lie algebra, making p=2 a natural and sharp bad-prime boundary. Geometry changes from two components of dimensions 3m, 2m+2 to one of dimension 3m+1. The odd-characteristic m>=3 non-equidimensional component and singularity formulas are natural invariants with motivated exact arithmetic and motivic counts, rather than a routine numerical increment. The char-zero pair case and char-two Heisenberg formulas are explicitly credited as prior implications.
